title: Are We Overthinking One-Step Generation?
abstract: Diffusion and flow matching are now dominant frameworks for generative modeling in continuous domains, but they typically require multiple network evaluations at inference. This has motivated extensive research on one-step generative modeling primarily built on diffusion and flow, though existing approaches often rely on complex training machinery. In this work, we introduce Priming Models, a simple two-stage framework for training one-step generators. Motivated by the difficulty of distributional training from scratch, Priming Models are first trained on a reconstruction objective, e.g., pixel-space denoising at a fixed noise level, before undergoing feature-space distributional post-training. Our central scientific finding is that this simple reconstruction stage is already enough to entirely alleviate the difficulty of distributional training. Empirically, across class-conditional image generation, text-to-image generation, and world modeling, Priming Models significantly advance the Pareto frontier of training compute vs. generation quality. On ImageNet at $256 \times 256$ resolution, we achieve a state-of-the-art FID of $1.19$ among one-step generators using approximately one-tenth the training compute of prior methods with comparable FID. We open-source our codebase at this https URL.

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: In our graduate course on generative modeling, today’s lecture is on “Are We Overthinking One-Step Generation?” Recent work such as “Mean Flows for One-step Generative Modeling” and “One-step Diffusion with Distribution Matching Distillation” reflects a clear trend: reduce sampling to one network evaluation. Researchers at Seoul National University and Harvard ask whether training needs to be equally elaborate. Their answer challenges the assumption that one-step generation requires complex machinery. Yes, Noah?
segments.zh: 在我们研究生的生成建模课上，今天这堂课讲的是“我们是不是把一步生成想得太复杂了？”最近的一些工作，比如“Mean Flows for One-step Generative Modeling”和“One-step Diffusion with Distribution Matching Distillation”，反映出一个明显的趋势：把采样缩减到一次网络评估。首尔国立大学和哈佛的研究人员问，训练是不是也得同样精细。他们的答案挑战了“一步生成需要复杂机制”这个假设。好，Noah？

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Hi Professor, is the main question whether a simpler training recipe can still produce high-quality samples?
segments.zh: 教授您好，主要问题是不是说，更简单的训练方案是否仍然能生成高质量的样本？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Exactly. Priming Models propose a two-stage recipe: first teach a network to reconstruct images from heavily corrupted inputs, then train it to match the distribution of real data. Unlike methods that distill a pretrained diffusion model, this approach does not need a diffusion teacher. It matters because fewer sampling steps can lower inference costs, while simpler training could make one-step generation more practical. The paper tests this idea in image generation, text-to-image, and world modeling.
segments.zh: 没错。Priming Models 提出了一个两阶段方案：先教网络从严重损坏的输入中重建图像，再训练它去匹配真实数据的分布。跟那些蒸馏预训练扩散模型的方法不同，这个方案不需要扩散教师模型。这之所以重要，是因为更少的采样步数可以降低推理成本，而更简单的训练则可能让一步生成变得更实用。论文在图像生成、文本到图像以及世界建模中测试了这个想法。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The first stage is reconstruction pretraining. The network sees an image mixed with Gaussian noise and learns to recover the original. Think of it as learning the visual grammar of images before being asked to invent new ones. The authors use a fixed corruption level for their principal ImageNet setup, preserving some target information while making the input resemble the noise used at generation time.
segments.zh: 第一阶段是重建预训练。网络看到的是混入高斯噪声的图像，学着还原出原图。可以把它理解为先学会图像的视觉语法，再被要求去创造新图像。作者在主要的ImageNet设置中使用了固定的损坏程度，既保留了一部分目标信息，又让输入接近生成时所用的噪声。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Quick question: why not train directly on random noise from the beginning?
segments.zh: 问个简单的问题：为什么不一开始就直接用随机噪声来训练呢？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The authors’ concern is that a randomly initialized network may not respond usefully to distribution-matching updates. A loss can indicate that generated samples should move in a certain direction, but the network may not yet know how to make that change. Reconstruction gives it a useful input-to-image mapping first. Importantly, the goal is not simply better reconstructions; that stage prepares the same network for direct distributional post-training.
segments.zh: 作者的顾虑是，随机初始化的网络可能无法对分布匹配的更新做出有效响应。损失函数可以指出生成样本应该朝某个方向移动，但网络可能还不知道如何实现这种改变。重建阶段先让它学会一个有用的从输入到图像的映射。重要的是，目标不仅仅是更好的重建；这个阶段是在为同一个网络后续的直接分布后训练做准备。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: In the second stage, Gaussian noise goes through the pretrained network to produce one-step samples. The authors compare generated images with real examples using frozen feature encoders and an entropy-regularized optimal transport objective. A generated-to-real term encourages matching, while a generated-to-generated reference term adds a repulsive effect to discourage collapse. No diffusion teacher is involved, though pretrained feature encoders remain part of the method.
segments.zh: 在第二阶段，高斯噪声经过预训练网络，一步生成样本。作者用冻结的特征编码器和熵正则化的最优传输目标，把生成图像和真实样本做比较。一个生成到真实的项鼓励匹配，而一个生成到生成的参考项则加入排斥效果，防止坍缩。整个过程不涉及扩散教师，不过预训练特征编码器仍然是方法的一部分。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Can you clarify what the repulsive term contributes beyond matching generated images to real ones?
segments.zh: 你能解释一下，除了把生成图像和真实图像匹配起来之外，这个排斥项还起了什么作用吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Matching alone can leave a generator producing too few varieties of samples. The reference term compares generated examples with other generated examples, but stops gradients through those reference samples. That adds a signal discouraging samples from crowding together. The intuition resembles arranging points so they cover the target distribution rather than piling up in one dense region. The paper also tests energy-distance and kernel-based alternatives to its principal objective.
segments.zh: 仅靠匹配可能让生成器产出的样本种类太少。参考项把生成的样本与其他生成样本做比较，但会阻断这些参考样本的梯度。这就加入了一个信号，抑制样本聚在一起。直观理解类似于把点摆开，让它们覆盖目标分布，而不是挤在一个密集区域里。论文还测试了能量距离和基于核的替代方案，来对比其主要目标函数。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The ImageNet experiments show why both stages matter. The pretrained network does not immediately generate strong one-step samples; quality improves substantially during post-training, with clean images appearing within the first 1,250 updates. The Large model reaches an F-I-D of 1.19 after 160 pretraining epochs, at a reported training cost of 238.95 exaFLOPs. Its comparison with selected baselines suggests a favorable quality-and-compute trade-off.
segments.zh: ImageNet实验说明了为什么这两个阶段都很重要。预训练网络并不能立刻生成高质量的一步样本；质量在后训练阶段大幅提升，前1250次更新内就出现了清晰的图像。Large模型在160个预训练轮次后达到1.19的F-I-D，报告的训练成本为238.95 exaFLOPs。与所选基线的对比表明，它在质量和计算量之间取得了有利的权衡。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: How much does the result depend on the reconstruction setup, rather than the post-training objective?
segments.zh: 结果在多大程度上取决于重建设置，而不是后训练目标？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The ablations indicate that pretraining choices matter. Among tested fixed corruption levels, 0.8 performs best, while 1.0, which removes information about the clean target, performs poorly. Removing perceptual supervision also worsens results. Masking and representation-based reconstruction remain workable, but do not match the default configuration. These findings support reconstruction as a meaningful preparation step, though they do not show that one particular recipe will be best for every dataset.
segments.zh: 消融实验表明，预训练阶段的选择很重要。在测试过的固定损坏程度中，0.8表现最好，而1.0因为完全抹掉了干净目标的信息，表现很差。去掉感知监督也会让结果变差。掩码和基于表征的重建仍然可行，但都比不上默认配置。这些发现支持把重建当作一个有意义的准备步骤，不过并不能说明某一种特定方案对所有数据集都是最优的。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: There is also evidence across different tasks. For text-to-image generation, one pretraining variant reaches GenEval 0.818 and DPG-Bench 82.16, exceeding the reported one-step MeanFlow scores and approaching its four-step results. A two-step Priming extension improves those metrics further. These comparisons suggest that the approach can extend beyond class-conditional ImageNet, although benchmark scores alone cannot tell us whether prompts are consistently followed in everyday use.
segments.zh: 不同任务上也都有证据。在文本到图像生成方面，一种预训练变体达到了GenEval 0.818和DPG-Bench 82.16，超过了所报告的一步MeanFlow分数，并接近其四步结果。两步Priming扩展进一步提升了这些指标。这些比较表明，该方法可以扩展到类条件ImageNet之外，尽管仅凭基准分数无法告诉我们，在日常使用中提示词是否被一致地遵循。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Does the same training idea help when the output is a future robot-camera frame?
segments.zh: 同样的训练思路，在输出是未来的机器人相机画面时，还能奏效吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The world-model experiments provide a useful test. Given recent observations and actions, Priming predicts future frames using latents from a pretrained image encoder. On RT-1 and Bridge-V2, it beats the one-step Drifting baseline on all reported metrics. Compared with 32-step flow matching, it has better reported image metrics on both datasets, but a higher F-V-D on RT-1. Its training compute is also lower than Drifting’s on both datasets.
segments.zh: 世界模型的实验提供了一个有用的检验。给定最近的观测和动作，Priming 利用预训练图像编码器产生的潜在表示来预测未来帧。在 RT-1 和 Bridge-V2 上，它在所有报告的指标上都优于单步 Drifting 基线。与 32 步流匹配相比，它在两个数据集上报告的图像指标都更好，但在 RT-1 上的 F-V-D 更高。它在两个数据集上的训练计算量也都低于 Drifting。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: These results position Priming alongside, but distinct from, approaches such as MeanFlow and distribution-matching distillation. Those works explore efficient generation through different objectives or by using a teacher. Priming instead treats reconstruction as the bridge between an untrained network and direct distribution matching. The paper’s Jacobian-alignment analysis offers a possible explanation: models that respond more strongly along estimated correction directions tend to achieve lower F-I-D after post-training.
segments.zh: 这些结果把Priming与MeanFlow、分布匹配蒸馏这类方法放在了一起，但又有所区别。那些工作是通过不同的目标函数或借助教师模型来探索高效生成。而Priming则把重建当作一座桥梁，连接未经训练的网络和直接的分布匹配。论文的雅可比对齐分析给出了一种可能的解释：在估计的修正方向上响应更强的模型，在后训练之后往往能达到更低的F-I-D。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Is that alignment evidence enough to establish why the method works?
segments.zh: 这个对齐证据足以说明该方法为什么有效吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: No. The relationship is consistent with the authors’ explanation, but it does not prove alignment is the sole cause of the gains. The broader implication is a useful change in emphasis: rather than asking only how to compress a sampling trajectory, researchers can ask what preliminary task makes direct generation easier to optimize. Still, Priming relies on pretrained feature encoders, and its results cover a defined set of datasets and configurations, so broader applicability remains an open question.
segments.zh: 不能。这种关系符合作者的解释，但并不能证明对齐是带来提升的唯一原因。更广泛的意义在于，它带来了一种有用的重心转变：研究者不再只问如何压缩采样轨迹，还可以问什么样的预训练任务能让直接生成更容易优化。不过，Priming仍然依赖预训练的特征编码器，而且其结果只覆盖一组特定的数据集和配置，所以更广泛的适用性仍是一个未解的问题。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The key takeaway is that one-step generation may benefit less from elaborate trajectory machinery than from a well-chosen starting point. Priming Models first teach a network to recover images from corruption, then refine its output distribution directly. The results make that recipe worth testing in other settings, while leaving important questions about feature-encoder dependence and generalization. Thanks for listening. If you have any further questions, ask our AI assistant or drop a comment.
segments.zh: 关键结论是，一步生成可能不太需要复杂的轨迹机制，更重要的反而是选好一个起点。Priming Models 先教网络从损坏图像中恢复，然后直接优化它的输出分布。这个结果说明这套方法值得在其他场景里试一试，但特征编码器依赖和泛化性这些重要问题仍然没有解决。感谢收听。如果还有问题，可以问我们的 AI 助手，或者留言评论。
